item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 19/Jun/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring showers to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. With the anticyclone aloft over the western North Pacific extending westwards, the weather will be fine and very hot over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of this week.

Date/Month: 20/06 (Monday)
Wind: South force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground.
Weather: Sunny intervals and one or two showers.
Temp range: 28 - 31 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 21/06 (Tuesday)
